reasons: CS3263 requires CS2109S, but CS3243 cannot be taken if CS2109S is completed and is mutually exclusive with CS3263.
The must-take list includes both CS3243 and CS3263, so no valid plan can include all required courses.
CS1101S must be before CS2040S in Y1S2, so the wish to pair CS1101S with CS4220 is also impossible.
